name: MiM: Meditation Interactive Matrix
detailed_description:
About This Game
Discover a next-level wellness playground that blends mindful practices with playful mini-games in a sleek sci-fi interface. Journey through guided chakra alignment, cosmic arcade challenges, weather simulations, and customizable soundscapes—all designed to center your mind and spark joy.

Key Features

  • MediDrive Engine – Advanced biofeedback and quantum resonance guide you through chakra-alignment sessions with adaptive light and sound.

  • HoloSphere Arcade – Zero-gravity mini-games (Golf, Billiards, Pong, Basketball) fused with ambient soundscapes to turn play into a meditative ritual.

  • PrecipiTech Engine – Dial in rainfall intensity, thunder and lightning effects, and layered atmospherics for instant calm.

  • ChromaTone Generator – Sculpt your perfect soundscape by mixing color noise (white, pink, brown, blue, etc.), soothing effects, and curated playlists.

  • Beta Basement Demo – Unlock hidden Easter eggs to sample our rough-around-the-edges Flight Simulator, Driving module, Party Simulator, and Keys station—glitches and all.

Why You’ll Love It
Whether you need a moment of deep relaxation or a burst of joyful distraction, this all-in-one experience adapts to your state of mind. Track your progress with in-app analytics, personalize every session, and explore unreleased prototypes for a peek at what’s next. Perfect for meditation enthusiasts, casual gamers, and anyone craving a futuristic twist on self-care.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: n/a
  • Additional Notes: Bio-sensor hardware optional; game runs without it.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Surround-capable recommended
  • VR Support: n/a
  • Additional Notes: For highest-fidelity visuals and room-scale bio-feedback.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 570 (proprietary drivers)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA/PulseAudio compatible
  • VR Support: n/a
  • Additional Notes: 32-bit compatibility libraries required
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (proprietary drivers)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Surround-capable recommended
  • VR Support: n/a
  • Additional Notes: Proprietary GPU drivers strongly recommended for best performance.
